common_name: Alligator Rock Hosta (Corrugated Deep Green Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Alligator Rock is a Don Rawson introduction forming a medium-to-large mound of rich deep green leaves with thick substance and tight, even corrugation that gives the surface a reptilian texture. White flowers rise above the foliage in summer and read as a clean contrast against the dark leaves. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade for the most pronounced leaf texture and least leaf scorch.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Ambrosia Hosta (Blue-Margined Yellow-Centered Guacamole Sport)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Ambrosia is Bob Solberg's 2015 Green Hill Farm sport of 'Guacamole', keeping its parent's fragrant white flowers while trading places on the color pattern to a blue-green margin surrounding a light yellow center. It builds into a large, vigorous clump that tolerates brighter light than most blue-margined hostas. Plant in moist, humus-rich soil in part shade to full morning sun for the clearest color contrast between margin and center.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Blueberry Parfait Hosta (Cupped Blue Hosta with White-Backed Leaves)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Blueberry Parfait, a 2024 introduction from J. McBurney and R. Kuenster bred from Rod Kuenster's 'Rock Concert' and 'Abiqua Drinking Gourd' lines, forms a medium-to-large mound of cupped, ruffled, rounded blue leaves edged in a creamy white margin. The leaves are held so that their pale undersides show, adding a two-tone effect to the clump through midsummer. Grow in consistently moist, well-drained, humus-rich soil in shade to limit the fading that strong sun brings to blue-leaved hostas.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Breakwater Hosta (Flame-Patterned Yellow-Margined Montana Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Breakwater is a 2020 Randy Goodwin selection from Hosta montana seedling stock, with pointed, heart-shaped leaves whose bright yellow margins cut deeply into the green center in an irregular, flame-like pattern. The clump spreads its leaves widely and is most effective when massed rather than grown as a single specimen. Site in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade, where the strong variegation contrast holds best.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Briar Patch Hosta (Ruffled Prickly-Leaved Mini Blue Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Briar Patch, a 2014 Randy Goodwin introduction, makes a tight, tangled mound of small blue leaves so highly ruffled and sharply pointed that the clump reads as prickly from a distance despite its soft texture up close. Its small scale suits rock gardens, troughs, and the front edge of a shaded bed. Grow in evenly moist, well-drained, humus-rich soil in shade to keep the blue cast from washing out.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Buttonwood Bay Hosta (Ruffled Pointed-Leaf Blue Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Buttonwood Bay is Bob Solberg's 2023 Green Hill Farm introduction from 'Tongue Twister' and 'Iwa' x 'Blue Blush' breeding, forming a medium mound of intensely blue, ruffled, pointed leaves that catch light in waves across the clump. It is a comparatively new, still-limited release from the nursery's Classic Hosta Liners program. Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade, where the blue color is deepest and longest-lasting.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Chicago Blues Hosta (Purple-Petioled Sieboldiana Hybrid)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Chicago Blues is a 2022 Green Hill Farm introduction from Bob Solberg's third-generation 'Longiana' breeding line (Hosta sieboldiana crossed through 'One Man's Treasure'), notable among its siblings for the strongest purple cast to its petioles. In May the deep, heavily white-waxed blue foliage itself takes on a purple-tinged sheen that fades as the wax weathers through summer. It is an unusually sturdy grower, reportedly performing especially well in containers, and prefers moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Clear Blue Sky Hosta (Long-Holding Upright Blue Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Clear Blue Sky, a 2023 Green Hill Farm cross of 'Summer Squall' and 'Fragrant Blue' bred by Bob Solberg specifically for an upright habit and long-lasting blue color, keeps its foliage looking fresh and blue well into fall when many other blue hostas have faded to green. Its 'Longiana' ancestry shows in the clean, crisp look of the mound. Grow in evenly moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade for the best color retention through the season.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Coconut Custard Hosta (Purple-Petioled Yellow Mini Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Coconut Custard is a Bob Solberg Green Hill Farm mini from 'Blue Cadet' and 'One Man's Treasure' breeding, forming a small, dependable clump of yellow foliage marked by purple petioles hidden beneath the leaves. It often pushes an entirely new flush of leaves in late summer, giving it two distinct looks across a season. Best grown in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with some afternoon shade in hot climates, where it also performs well as a container specimen.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Cosmic Dew Hosta (White-Margined Mini Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Cosmic Dew is a Rod Kuenster mini hosta that forms a tight, flat mound of small, white-margined leaves, scaled for troughs and container culture rather than open border planting. Its compact habit keeps it tidy without division for several seasons. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part to full shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Fairy Dust Hosta (Season-Long Bright Yellow Mini Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Fairy Dust is a 2019 Bob Solberg Green Hill Farm mini from 'Corkscrew' and 'Green Eyes' breeding, producing very bright yellow foliage with good substance that holds its color from spring through fall rather than fading to green. Its small scale and reliable color make it a favorite for fairy-garden and miniature plantings. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with some morning sun to maintain the clearest yellow tone.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Hat Trick Hosta (Pure White-Margined World Cup Sport)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Hat Trick is a sport of the AHGA Hosta of the Year 'World Cup' discovered by M. Zilis and R. Solberg, substituting a pure white margin for its parent's more muted edge while keeping the same cupped, upright, architectural leaves. Growers at Green Hill Farm report it performing even more vigorously than 'World Cup' itself, with the mirror-image symmetry of leaves on either side of the clump. Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade for a strongly upright specimen presence.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Hogwarts Hosta (Heavily Textured Thick Dark Green Montana Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Hogwarts is a 2022 introduction from D. and M. Beilstein, bred from 'Clear Fork River Valley' and a 'Brutus' x Hosta montana f. macrophylla cross, producing extremely thick, dark green leaves covered in a dense, bumpy, wart-like texture unusual for the genus. Despite the name's playful nod to a certain fictional school, the texture itself is the main attraction, inviting close inspection and touch. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Light the Match Hosta (Red-Blushing Yellow Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Light the Match is Doug Ruff's selection from 'Swoosh' x 'Raving Beauty' crossed again onto 'First Blush', among the first of the yellow 'blushing' hostas descended from that line, with narrow, wavy leaves that emerge bright yellow with red blushing running down from the leaf tips toward the base. The red fades as summer heat builds but the yellow base color persists, and the plant is a notably vigorous, quick-clumping grower. Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade, with some morning sun to encourage the spring blush.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Little Squirt Hosta (Pin-Cushion Mini Green Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Little Squirt, a 2021 D. and M. Beilstein mini from 'Little Jim' and 'Green Sheen' breeding, grows quickly into a compact clump of long, narrow, slightly folded and ruffled green leaves on short petioles that together give the mound a pin-cushion look. Short scapes carry well-proportioned white flowers in summer. Its dense, quick-spreading habit also suits use as a small-scale shade groundcover; grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part to full shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Midnight Oil Hosta (Near-Black Shiny Dark Green Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Midnight Oil, a 2004 introduction from B. and D. Stegeman bred from 'Potomac Pride' and 'Neat Splash Rim', produces broad, shiny leaves in one of the darkest greens available in the genus, appearing nearly black under low shade-garden light. The glossy leaf surface helps the dark color read as rich rather than dull. Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade, where the color is deepest and the shine is most apparent.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Minnesota Moon Hosta (Hypoleuca-Derived Bright Yellow Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Minnesota Moon is a 2025 selection from Monty Carlson and Bob Solberg out of Hosta hypoleuca seedling stock, with bright yellow foliage that holds its color through summer heat and still looks fresh into September, longer than many gold hostas manage. The medium-to-large mound has a soft glow in shaded settings rather than a harsh, flat yellow. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with some morning sun to sustain the yellow tone.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Mouse Madness Hosta (Vigorous White-Edged Solar Mouse Sport)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Mouse Madness is a 2020 Green Hill Farm sport of the famously difficult all-white 'Solar Mouse', discovered by Bob Solberg, that keeps its parent's bright white margins but trades the weak all-white growth for a far more vigorous, dependable plant. The white edges emerge bright in spring and hold their crispness well into late summer without melting out to green. Grow this mini in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part to full shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Mouse on the Moon Hosta (Larger White-Margined Mouse Madness Sport)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Mouse on the Moon is Bob Solberg's 2025 Green Hill Farm sport of 'Mouse Madness', keeping the same non-melting bright white margins while sporting to faster-growing tissue that gives the clump a slightly twisted, dancing leaf habit. It also runs larger and tougher than its parent, making it an easier mouse-series hosta to establish. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part to full shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Peach Brandy Hosta (Purple-Petioled Puckered Yellow Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Peach Brandy is a 2022 Green Hill Farm introduction from Bob Solberg's red-petioled yellow hosta line, with folded and puckered yellow leaves pierced by a deep purple petiole that extends halfway or more up the center vein. In summer the leaves take on an overall purple blush that gives the plant its brandy-toned cast, and the purple petiole color persists even as the leaves melt down in late fall. Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade for the fullest petiole and blush color.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Pineapple Salsa Hosta (Red-Petioled Mango Salsa Sport)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Pineapple Salsa is Bob Solberg's 2021 Green Hill Farm sport of 'Mango Salsa', an improvement on its popular parent with thick, slightly wavy dark green margins surrounding bright yellow centers. Rich red petioles extend into the base of the leaf, adding a third color note to the medium-sized clump. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Plum Delicious Hosta (Blue Ruffled Plum Pudding Seedling)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Plum Delicious is a 2021 Green Hill Farm seedling of the popular 'Plum Pudding' bred by Bob Solberg, carrying plum-red petioles on both the front and back of the leaf that extend up into intensely colored, ruffled blue foliage. It is essentially a blue-leaved counterpart to its parent and has reportedly sold out quickly in past liner offerings. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade to keep the blue leaf color from fading.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: River Valley Gold Hosta (Corrugated Upright Gold Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: River Valley Gold is a 2023 introduction from Bob and Linda Fox crossing 'Clear Fork River Valley' with 'High Noon', combining the heavily corrugated leaf texture of the former with the upright habit and gold color of the latter. The result is a large hosta with strong textural presence as well as color. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with some morning sun to bring out the gold tone.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Ruffles N Ridges Hosta (Huge Ruffled Deep-Veined Blue Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Ruffles N Ridges, a 2018 Bob and Gail Fox cross of 'Komodo Dragon' and 'Powder Blue', is among the largest hostas available, reaching waist height with a spread approaching six feet. Its huge, ruffled, rounded leaves carry deep veining that gives the whole clump a strongly textured, almost sculptural presence. Grow in consistently moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade, allowing ample room for its eventual mature size.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Sip of Wine Hosta (Purple-Veined Red October Seedling)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Sip of Wine is Bob Solberg's 2025 Green Hill Farm introduction, a second-generation seedling from 'Red October' whose persistent purple pigment runs through the petioles and up into the leaf veins rather than simply blushing the leaf surface. The effect rewards close viewing, with fine purple venation visible across the medium-sized leaves. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Smash Hit Hosta (Wide-Margined Orange Marmalade Sport)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Smash Hit is an M. Zilis sport of 'Orange Marmalade' with a notably wider blue-green margin than its parent, a trait suggesting improved vigor from a tetraploid shift. The bright yellow leaf center emerges in spring, turns orange, and fades toward near-white by summer, with lavender flowers appearing in July. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade for best color development through the season.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Smokey Mountain Blues Hosta (Huge Waxy Blue Empress Wu Hybrid)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in deep shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Smokey Mountain Blues is a 2023 Clarence Hanna cross of 'Empress Wu' and 'Powder Blue', producing an enormous, heavily waxed blue mound that lives up to its giant parentage. Lavender flowers appear atop the huge clump in summer, and the plant has reportedly grown faster in cultivation than its size would suggest. Grow in consistently moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade, with plenty of room to reach its mature spread.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Tom Terrific Hosta (Upright Purple-Petioled Large Yellow Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Tom Terrific is a Bob Solberg Green Hill Farm hosta from 48/49 seedling and 'Key West' breeding, with 'Elegans' visible in its background through its large, rounded, upright yellow leaves and prominently visible rich purple petioles. It forms an impressive specimen-sized clump named for Tom Micheletti. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with some morning sun to bring out the yellow leaf color.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: The Trophy Wife Hosta (Copper-Flushed Early Gold Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: The Trophy Wife is a Bob and Gail Fox cross of 'Blaze of Glory' and 'Komodo Dragon', opening gold in early season before shifting through chartreuse to a showstopping copper tone, with a wavy leaf margin and a distinctive twist at the leaf tip. It grows as a surprisingly tall, upright, very large hosta that settles to green as summer heat sets in. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with some morning sun to see the full color sequence.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Wildest Dreams Hosta (Grey-Streaked Cream-Margined Large Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Wildest Dreams, a 2019 collaboration between R. McWilliams, Doug Ruff, and Bob Solberg from Hosta 'Robb's Dream' crossed onto an unknown parent, is valued for the grey streaking that runs through its large, variegated leaves beneath wide, gently undulating cream margins. Dense clusters of lavender flowers appear in July on scapes above the 13-inch leaves. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)

common_name: Yippee Hosta (Upright White-Margined Mini Hosta)

planting.note: Plant container stock or divisions in spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; set the crown at or slightly above grade and water in well while new roots establish.

directions: Yippee, a 2020 D. and M. Beilstein mini from a multi-generation cross involving 'Salute', 'Lizard Lick', and 'Atom Smasher', holds its small white-margined leaves almost straight up rather than in the typical mounded habit of most minis. Its upright form adds height and verticality when grouped with other miniature hostas in bowls or small containers. Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in part to full shade.
sources: Green Hill Farm, Inc. (Bob Solberg) -- Spring 2026 Hosta Liner List, January Availability (hostahosta.com/WMO26_spring_liner_January.pdf)
